## Task Complete

I've recorded **USD 36,000 in March revenue** for the Evergreen Bank implementation project. Here's what I found:

### Key Findings:

**✓ M1 Solution Design (USD 36,000)** — Recognized in March
- Formally accepted by customer on March 14, 2026 (signed certificate DOC-0184)
- Meets ASC 606 requirement: control of deliverable transferred at acceptance

**✗ M2 Build & Integration (USD 60,000)** — Not recognized
- Only 80% complete as of March 27 per project manager
- **No acceptance certificate** — performance obligation not yet satisfied
- Cannot recognize under ASC 606 despite substantial completion

**✗ M3 UAT & Go-live (USD 24,000)** — Not recognized  
- Not yet started

### Journal Entry Posted (JE-00305):
- **Debit:** Deferred Revenue (2200) — USD 36,000
- **Credit:** Professional Services Revenue (4200) — USD 36,000
- **Date:** March 14, 2026
- **Status:** Pending controller approval (exceeds USD 10,000 threshold)

### Reasoning:
The contract explicitly ties revenue recognition to customer acceptance of each milestone. Under ASC 606, this means control transfers only upon formal acceptance. While M2 is substantively complete, the absence of a signed acceptance certificate means the performance obligation remains unsatisfied and revenue cannot be recognized—this is the correct application of ASC 606 even when work is substantially done.
